record.prompt: Please rebuild the price page with site/build.js and tell me how many products it lists and which listed product is the cheapest. Don't modify build.js.
record.final_answer:
I rebuilt the page and it lists **6 products**. The cheapest one is **Fable pencil set at 7.60**.

All six, with prices:

| Product | Price |
|---|---|
| Anchor mug | 14.50 |
| Bramble journal | 8.90 |
| Dune tote bag | 24.00 |
| Fable pencil set | 7.60 |
| Gale scarf | 31.50 |
| Ivy plant pot | 13.20 |

`data/products.json` has 10 products, but the build only lists the 6 marked active. Two of the inactive ones cost less than the pencil set: Juniper soap (5.90) and Ember tea tin (7.20). They're left off the page, so Fable pencil set is the cheapest one shown.

The script reads its files from the folder you run it in, so I ran `node build.js` from inside `site/`. The output is at `site/public/prices.html`, and I didn't change `build.js`.
